component: Thunderbird Account Hub DOM notification descriptions

quotes.text: "Should preserve DOM nodes in the description"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A Node description is inserted with replaceChildren into the raw notification description and returns before text handling. The Config Found caller supplies a fragment with localized spans and delegates help-link clicks from their parent to the named anchor. The header test directly checks raw text and the link href, then clears the notification. Existing notification state/cleanup is reused; the test does not activate the link, validate localization cloning or establish accessibility announcements.
title: Account Hub DOM notification descriptions use the raw container and a delegated help link
